title: Course
description: Represents a University of Maryland course as scraped from Testudo and exposed by the umd.io API.

course_id.description: A unique string ID with a four-letter dept_id followed by a three digit course number and an optional letter.

semester.description: Numeric representation of the semester, in format YYYYMM.

department.description: Full name of the department that offers the course.

credits.description: The number of credits the course is worth.

description.description: String description of the course, as it appears on Testudo.

grading_method.description: Array of string grading options available: Regular, Pass-Fail, Audit, Sat-Fail.

gen_ed.description: General Education requirements the course fulfills. Array of arrays: outer layer is OR, inner layer is AND.

core.description: Array of strings of CORE requirements filled by a course.

coreqs.description: Courses that must be taken with this one.

formerly.description: Previous course codes that were the same course.

restrictions.description: Additional restrictions/requirements for taking the course.

additional_info.description: Any additional information listed on Testudo.

also_offered_as.description: Other course codes representing the same course (cross-listing).

credit_granted_for.description: Courses that are equivalent in credit.

sections.description: The sections of this course, either section ids or full Section objects.
